manual.title: Create a manual meter
manual.description: Create one entity for this utility meter.

import_csv.title: Import a meter from CSV
import_csv.description: The import page is part of your own Home Assistant instance. No CSV data is sent to an external website or service. Open the page, select an exported CSV file, confirm the suggested or a new meter name, and choose a unit if the page offers a choice.

export_statistics.title: Export an Energy Dashboard meter
export_statistics.description: The export page is part of your own Home Assistant instance. No meter data is sent to an external website or service. Open the page, select a compatible meter, and choose a CSV unit if the page offers a choice.

data_description.gas_calorific_value: Use the calorific value from the gas bill for CSV conversions between volume and energy.
data_description.gas_correction_factor: Use the volume correction factor from the gas bill for the relevant period.

vision.title: Configure photo recognition
vision.description: Configure an OpenAI-compatible vision provider for this meter. Leave the provider address empty to disable photo recognition. Model and prompt are stored independently with this meter.

data_description.vision_compress_image: Enabled: converts the photo to JPEG, limits its longest edge to 1600 pixels and its output size to 2 MiB, and removes embedded metadata. Disabled: sends an original JPEG, PNG, or WebP file unchanged up to 20 MiB, including embedded metadata. Enabled by default.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure meter
reconfigure.description: Changes apply only to this meter. Leave the API token empty to retain the stored token, or select Remove stored API token to delete it.

data_description.vision_compress_image: Enabled: converts the photo to JPEG, limits its longest edge to 1600 pixels and its output size to 2 MiB, and removes embedded metadata. Disabled: sends an original JPEG, PNG, or WebP file unchanged up to 20 MiB, including embedded metadata. Enabled by default.
